sources.title: Prompt Repetition Improves Non-Reasoning LLMs
sources.evidence: Seven API models; QA/math plus two synthetic retrieval tasks, not executable coding. With reasoning disabled,47/70 combinations improved under authors McNemar p<0.1 convention,0losses. With step-by-step encouragement:5wins/1loss/22ties. Long Anthropic requests sometimes increased latency; API timing has network/load uncertainty.
sources.implication: Re-exposure is plausible, but no local latency, automatic selection, temporal authority or coding benefit is established.
sources.confidence: high for reported methods; transfer unproven
sources.next_gap: Compare selected original evidence to ordinary history and an equal-budget recency source control, prospectively; do not import benchmarks.

sources.title: We Are What We Repeatedly Do: Improving Long Context Instruction Following
sources.authors: Robinette et al.; Google DeepMind and Vanderbilt; ACL
sources.evidence: Reinstruct repeats a known instruction on the next user turn when noncompliance is detected. Evaluation uses28 instructions across10verifiable formats and fourGemma/Llama models. Authors limit claims about qualitative quality/factuality and explicitly omit system prompts.
sources.implication: Supports reminders of known rules, not automatic identification of current ones or coding competence. A detector with known instructions is an extra oracle in transfer.
sources.confidence: high for method/limitations; no claimed local effect size
sources.next_gap: Need independent executable outcomes; no instruction-gold perfection gate.

sources.title: Language Models Can Control Their Own Attention
sources.evidence: Declarative global/focus/local masks tested on15fixed-context QA sources. Code_repo is repository QA, not execution. Largest Gemma/Qwen average accuracy drops1.27/2.75percentage points; smaller Gemma/Qwen retain29%/64%baseline accuracy. Protocol increases decoding; reported optimized decode time0.71x/0.77x is B200 roofline modeling.
sources.implication: Readable selection is possible, but this does not justify replacing local inference engine, new model downloads or reopening old steering as proven. Full-context unmasked protocol ablation raises attention cost rather than proving coding improvement.
sources.confidence: high for stated boundary; local benefit unknown
sources.next_gap: No further kernel research for this source-evidence quick-check decision.
